\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\newcount\PModel
\newcount\PBoundary
\newcount\PEntry
\def\PFail#1{\PackageError{boundary-model}{#1}{Independent edge-cut expectation failed.}}
% Phase 8B observer: project stored owners only for frozen depth assertions.
% Legacy and owner-list sources run this same fixture without compatibility code.
\newif\ifPOwnerLists
\ifdefined\dte@foreach@owner\POwnerListstrue\else\POwnerListsfalse\fi
\def\PProject#1{%
  \edef\PRaw{#1}%
  \ifPOwnerLists
    \let\PActual\@empty
    \@for\PItem:=\PRaw\do{%
      \edef\PDepth{\dte@eget{\PItem}{d}}%
      \ifx\PActual\@empty
        \let\PActual\PDepth
      \else
        \edef\PActual{\PActual,\PDepth}%
      \fi}%
  \else
    \let\PActual\PRaw
  \fi}
\def\PFindOwner#1#2{%
  \edef\PReadList{#1}\def\PFound{0}%
  \@for\PItem:=\PReadList\do{%
    \ifnum\dte@eget{\PItem}{d}=#2\relax
      \ifnum\PFound=0\else\PFail{Duplicate stored owner depth #2}\fi
      \let\PFound\PItem
    \fi}}
\def\PStart#1{%
  \advance\PModel by1 \dte@cnt=0
  \@for\PDepth:=#1\do{%
    \advance\dte@cnt by1
    \expandafter\edef\csname dte@e\the\dte@cnt d\endcsname{\PDepth}}%
  \dte@preprocess
  \dte@i=777 \dte@breakcount=888}
\def\PCheck#1#2#3#4{%
  \advance\PBoundary by1
  \PProject{\dte@safeget{dte@e#1a}}\def\PExpected{#2}%
  \ifx\PActual\PExpected\else\PFail{Active set at model \the\PModel/entry #1}\fi
  \ifnum\dte@eget{#1}{l}=#3\relax\else\PFail{Last-child flag}\fi
  \dte@store@breaklines{#1}{1}%
  \PProject{\dte@safeget{dte@breaklines@1}}\def\PExpected{#4}%
  \ifx\PActual\PExpected\else\PFail{Boundary set at model \the\PModel/entry #1}\fi
  \ifnum\dte@i=777\else\PFail{Outer index changed}\fi
  \ifnum\dte@breakcount=888\else\PFail{Break counter changed}\fi
  \ifnum\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@1}=#1\relax\else\PFail{Break index changed}\fi}
\def\POwner#1#2#3{%
  \ifPOwnerLists
    % Each frozen owner fact checks the actual stored boundary owner.
    \PFindOwner{\dte@safeget{dte@breaklines@1}}{#2}%
    \ifnum\PFound=#3\relax\else\PFail{Boundary style owner at #1/#2}\fi
    % Every active depth is also a boundary depth: check both producers.
    \ifnum#2>0
      \ifnum#2>\dte@eget{#1}{d}\relax\else
        \PFindOwner{\dte@safeget{dte@e#1a}}{#2}%
        \ifnum\PFound=#3\relax\else\PFail{Active style owner at #1/#2}\fi
      \fi
    \fi
  \else
    \dte@find@nextsibling{#1}{#2}%
    \ifnum\dte@nextidx=#3\relax\else\PFail{Style owner at #1/#2}\fi
  \fi}
